item.title: Hezbollah support endures in south Lebanon as ceasefire fails to stop war with Israel
item.description: Despite continuing Israeli attacks and occupation, many people in the south still believe the armed group is the only force capable of defending them.

item.title: Israeli strikes in southern Lebanon kill 22 people, health ministry says
item.description: Eight children are among those reported dead after a series of air strikes hit the south of Beirut.

item.title: Lebanon says Israeli strikes killed 39
item.description: Israel and Hezbollah have continued to trade fire despite a ceasefire deal being announced last month.

item.title: Netanyahu says he 'secretly visited' UAE during war with Iran
item.description: The UAE denied reports of the "alleged visit" and insisted relations between the two countries were not based on "unofficial arrangements".

item.title: EU agrees sanctions on Israeli settlers over West Bank violence
item.description: The EU's foreign policy chief said "extremism and violence carry consequences", while Israel branded the move "arbitrary".

item.title: 'Floating armoury' ship reportedly seized by Iran
item.description: A vessel said to be a “floating armoury” in the Gulf of Oman has been seized by Iranian military personnel, according to reports.

item.title: Trump calls Iran response to US proposal to end war 'totally unacceptable'
item.description: Iran is reported to want lifting of the US naval blockade, recognition of Iranian sovereignty over the Strait of Hormuz and compensation for war damage.

item.title: Hamas can survive politically by giving up weapons and armed conflict, peace envoy says
item.description: Nickolay Mladenov also warns the current stalemate over Donald Trump's peace plan could lead to a permanent division of the territory.

item.title: Trump says Iran ceasefire is on 'massive life support'
item.description: The US president criticises an Iranian counteroffer to end the war, and says the month-long ceasefire is "unbelievably weak".

item.title: Israel deports two activists detained on board Gaza flotilla
item.description: Spanish national Saif Abu Keshek and Brazilian Thiago Ávila were detained by Israel after sailing in a Gaza-bound aid flotilla.
